decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that strengthens the firm's core infrared heater range, and having invested in its development, management will keep it despite the 2022 gas price turbulence, which it reads as temporary.
Presented prominently on its own page and central to the firm's gas infrared offer, the plaque heater represents a visible commitment that management will defend and justify.
The luminous radiant heater sits in the firm's narrow core range of gas infrared products, so any weak demand is attributed to the temporary energy crisis rather than a flaw in the product.
As a multi-model tube heater line, it embodies the largest sunk investment and the clearest strategic commitment, making withdrawal very unlikely.
Although it overlaps somewhat with Product B, the standard plaque heater was publicly featured on its own page and anchors the firm's entry-level offer, so management will retain it.
This tube heater overlaps with the D line, which raises some risk of consolidation, but it belongs to the firm's core gas-fired direction and is likely to be kept.
